invariants.name: Explicit wait and complete authorization

Verifies plain labelled local volumes, exact Linux/UNC identity, UID/GID10001, 0700 roots, 0600 regular files, nlink1, membership/bytes and complete owner/mount sets; rejects aliases, extra mounts/owners and metadata drift. Full production two-owner host composition remains a later gate.
